a.lede: The 2027 BMW 330 starts at $49,900, the i3 50 xDrive at $61,500.
a.title: BMW reveals US 3 series pricing: The EV carries a hefty premium

b.lede: The new BMW 3 Series shows just how quickly EVs have caught up to fossil fuel vehicles on pricing.
b.title: BMW built the same car for gas and electric. The EV is $4,400 cheaper.
